original_description: Tell the plugin about your blog audience and the topics you want to cover, and it will generate a ready to publish blog site on B12 — hosting, design, and layout handled. Built for service businesses and professionals who want to start publishing without setting up a website first.
summary_ja: 対象読者や話題を伝え、B12上で公開準備が整ったブログサイトを作る。
limitations: 実際の公開手順・料金・機能・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
